advisory.checklist_item: - [ ] Confirm env_integration closes without bot-alert provenance still succeed when the completion gate is disabled (do not refuse before the gate-skip check).
evidence: close_precheck.py:686-688: `_bot_alert_disposition(...)` runs, then close_precheck.py:690 `skip = _gate_skip_expectation(...)` — the gate-off/skip check happens AFTER the bot-alert refusal

advisory.finding: The `_bot_alert_disposition` refusal fires regardless of whether the completion-verification gate is enabled: `_completion_precheck` is called on every close-to-closed, and `_bot_alert_disposition` runs before `_gate_skip_expectation`. With the gate OFF, an env_integration close that previously succeeded (gate_off skip) is now refused when provenance is absent.
scenarios: Repository has the completion gate disabled; a user closes any bug with `--class env_integration`

evidence: close_precheck.py:534 `if detected_by not in _BOT_ALERT_DETECTORS:` — the bypass key is `detected_by`
composer.py:235-239 sets `data["detected_by"]` from `resolve_detected_by(detected_by)` with only strip+lowercase, no value authorization
_config_resolvers.py:315-320 `resolve_detected_by` returns the explicit param or `REBAR_DETECTED_BY` env var verbatim
_cli/_parsers/core/writes.py:44 `parser.add_argument("--detected-by", help="detected_by:<gate> tag (bugs)")` — freely settable to any string by any creator
ADR 0117 asserts the guard relies on 'immutable detected_by provenance', but nothing restricts who may assert an allowlisted detector value at CREATE
advisory.finding: The `_bot_alert_disposition` completion-verification bypass authorizes solely on `detected_by`, which is client-supplied at CREATE via the freely-settable `--detected-by` CLI flag / `REBAR_DETECTED_BY` env var with no server-side restriction on its value. Any actor able to create a bug can set `detected_by=heartbeat-canary` (or another allowlisted detector) and then close it with `--class env_integration`, skipping the completion verifier the guard is meant to protect.

blocking.checklist_item: - [ ] Ensure a human `--class env_integration` close on a normal bug (no bot-alert provenance) still routes to completion verification instead of being hard-refused by _bot_alert_disposition.
evidence: close_precheck.py:534: `if detected_by not in _BOT_ALERT_DETECTORS:` then raises CommandError 'ordinary tickets must pass completion verification'

Old behavior: a human env_integration bug close was verified; new behavior at close_precheck.py:686-688 intercepts and refuses before the verifier can run
blocking.finding: Any `--class env_integration` close on a ticket without bot-alert `detected_by` provenance is now hard-refused with CommandError, even though env_integration is documented as a normal completed-bug class for human closes. Previously such a close fell through to completion verification; now `_bot_alert_disposition` raises unconditionally when provenance is absent.
scenarios: A human closes a genuinely-fixed environment/integration bug with `--class env_integration --reason=...` on a ticket created without bot-alert provenance
blocking.suggested_fix: In _bot_alert_disposition, return _NO_DISPOSITION (fall through to normal completion verification) when detected_by is not a bot-alert detector, rather than raising CommandError.
